title: fix(plugin-approvals): the no-approver decide refusal and a multi-slot submitter notice read in the reader's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9Gqqp1VYZwEqbXEm1YsTjU)_

Fixes #36463

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziH9MVhWYLVCiw5eXB

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：提交人自己点「批准」被拒时，审批详情页和审批中心弹出的提示改用用户自己的语言（中文用户整句都是中文）；没人能审批时发给提交人的通知，即使列了好几个岗位，也整句按收件人的语言显示。
- 为什么做：属于「审批收尾」这一组工作，补上上一轮留下的两处英文残留。
- 出错会怎样：只影响这两句提示的文字，审批是否被拒、拒绝的规则和已保存的审计记录都不变，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## Widened door response (Clause-②)

The approvals routes (`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`, all nine that share `handleApprovalError`) now carry a marked `userMessage` at the top level of their flat `{ code, error }` refusal body on any mapped row whose thrown error is marked, the same member #34619 added for `RESUME_FAILED` on this door and that `ApiErrorSchema` already declares and `@objectstack/client` already lifts. Producers today: the two self-approve decide refusals, both on the `403 FORBIDDEN` row (`excludeSubmitter`, and the override self-approve kept under maintainer ruling 2026-11-17 option B). The member is absent when no producer marked one, so every other refusal body is byte-identical. Additive, so `yes (widening)`, patch, `Metadata-protocol: none` (precedents #34619, #35811; L1 S1 7122520696).

## Census

- **The console reader that shows a decide refusal.** Two places:
  - The request page's Approve button is the declared `type: 'api'` action `approval_approve`. Its failure text is read by `refusalEnvelopeMessage` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`, through `apiActionRefusalResult`. Both callers use it: the `apiHandler` in `useConsoleActionRuntime` and the one in `RecordDetailView`. Before this PR it read only `error.userMessage` of the ADR-0112 envelope. The approvals door answers the flat `{ code, error }` body, so the toast showed the English `error`.
  - The Approval Center's inline Approve: `humanizeError` in `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, called by `inlineApprove`. It answered every `FORBIDDEN` with the generic "You are not allowed to perform this action.", so the remedy was lost.
- **Which channel was reused.** A producer marks `userMessage` on the thrown error. The plugin already does this in `lockedError` (`lifecycle-hooks.ts`) and `snapshotQueryRefusal` (`payload-predicate-guard.ts`). The approvals mapper carries it at the top level of its flat body, the member its `RESUME_FAILED` stranded envelope already uses for `userMessage`. `@objectstack/client` lifts `userMessage` from that member too (`errorBody?.userMessage ?? errorBody?.error?.userMessage`). Where this differs from the dispatch: the `declaredUserMessage` block around `recognisedRefusal` relays an engine resume refusal. It is not a producer of approvals' own refusal text, so it was not the pattern used here.
- **The two refusals.** Both `excludeSubmitter` and the override self-approve now throw through one local helper, `refuseOwnApproval`. It keeps the `message` byte for byte (the existing English pins are unchanged and green) and sets `userMessage` from `submitterRefusalUserMessage` (`no-approver-note.ts`). That text uses the decider's `readerLabels(context).sentence`, with the position labels from the same `notePositionLabels` read. If the decider asked in no language, or the pack lacks one of the sentences, the whole text is English and names no user id. It is never half one language and half the other.
- **The submitter notice.** The messaging layer renders at delivery, per recipient (`NotificationTextRenderer.render`). It resolves a keyed param with `t(key, locale)` and no params, so a hole holds one text or one hole-free key. One list param cannot carry translated clauses, and the plugin cannot compose a list per reader, because the emit does not know the recipient's locale. This falsifies the dispatch's flatten-into-one-param route as stated. The route taken flattens the list into the **sentence** instead. `approvalNoApproverHoldingSlots2` to `…Slots8` are derived in every pack from that pack's own `approvalNoApproverHolding`, `approvalNoApproverSlot` and `approvalNoApproverSlotSeparator`. Each slot is a keyed `typeN` / `valueN` pair, the single-slot shape repeated. Nothing is translated twice, the messaging contract does not move, and the notice reads exactly what the timeline reads for the same slate (pinned for every pack and every size 2 to 8).
- **The timeline overlay** (`localizeRoutingNotes`) uses the same `noApproverWho` composition, through `noApproverNoteText(note, labels.sentence, …)`. It already renders any number of slots in the reader's language and is not touched.

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/translations/messages.ts`:
  - five authored sentences, `approvalDecideRefusedSubmitterExcluded`, `…OverrideOwnRequest`, `…AnotherApprover`, `…OverrideAnotherApprover` and `…OverrideWithdraw`, in all eleven packs;
  - the derived `approvalNoApproverHoldingSlotsN` sentences, built in `slotListSentences` and added to every shipped locale by `withSlotLists`;
  - `NO_APPROVER_NOTICE_MAX_SLOTS = 8`.
- `no-approver-note.ts`: `noApproverNotice` spells 2 to 8 slots inline (shared `slotParams`). It adds `submitterRefusalUserMessage`.
- `approval-service.ts`: the two decide refusals go through `refuseOwnApproval`. Behaviour is unchanged: both still refuse, with the same English `message`.
- `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`: `handleApprovalError` adds `userMessage` (read once through `declaredUserMessage`) to every mapped row when the producer marked one. An unmarked refusal gets exactly the body it had before.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`: `refusalBodyUserMessage` reads the envelope's `error.userMessage`, else a flat body's top-level `userMessage`. These are the two members the client lifts, through one predicate.
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`: `humanizeError` shows a marked refusal first.
- Changeset `.changeset/36463-no-approver-text-in-reader-language.md`, patch for `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (private, inert).

Prior rulings that govern the edited lines (check-prior-rulings over the touched files; quoted as they stand in the tree):
- `[Maintainer ruling 2026-11-17, option B]` on the override refusal: "The #3424 override never approves a request its actor submitted, whatever `excludeSubmitter` says." Kept exactly. Only the language of its text changes.
- `ApiErrorSchema.userMessage` (`packages/spec/src/api/contract.zod.ts`), "ruling record 6819749037, option C: text addressed to the end user comes back in the request's language, composed where it is produced". The `userMessage` is composed in the service, in the decider's language, with `en` as the last rung.
- The mapper's `[#13807, maintainer ruling 2026-09-04 batch #37]` stranded envelope and the code-anchored prefix strip ("converged here by the 2026-08-31 ruling") are not changed. The stranded spread still comes last.

## First reads (by risk)

1. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/no-approver-note.ts`: `submitterRefusalUserMessage` (the all-or-nothing English fallback) and the multi-slot arm of `noApproverNotice`.
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/translations/messages.ts`: `slotListSentences`, and the change of `enMessages` into the authored set plus the derived set.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`: `refusalBodyUserMessage`. It is shared by every `type: 'api'` action, so the top-level read is gated by the same `declaredUserMessage` predicate.

## Tests

- `no-approver-note.test.ts`:
  - the two-slot keyed shape;
  - zh-CN delivery is entirely Chinese, with each position by its pack label or else as stored;
  - every pack and every size 2 to 8 equals the timeline's sentence;
  - 9 slots keep one English `who`;
  - both refusals are entirely Chinese in zh-CN;
  - every pack composes every refusal with no hole left;
  - English when there is no reader language, and the whole text is English when a pack lacks any one sentence.
- `exclude-submitter.integration.test.ts`: each refusal carries the zh-CN `userMessage` while its `message` keeps the English byte for byte; a decider with no locale gets English that names no id; the control (another approver on the slate) gets the English "another approver" text.
- `admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts`: a two-slot submitter notice goes through the real `NotificationTextRenderer`, entirely Chinese in zh-CN, in Japanese for ja-JP, and with the English literal body unchanged.
- `rest-approvals-wire-codes.test.ts`: `403 FORBIDDEN` with `userMessage` at the top level, `ApiErrorSchema` parse green; control: unmarked and blank markings add no member.
- `flowLaunch.preDispatchRefusal-36390.test.tsx`: a flat approvals refusal's top-level `userMessage` is the toast, through a real `ActionRunner`; control: an unmarked or blank one shows the `error`.
- `ApprovalsInboxPage.inlineActionsVisible-34587.test.tsx`: the inline Approve's failure toast is the marked text; control: the generic line.

## Acceptance notes

- **Slates of more than 8 slots.** The notice still names their slots in English inside the recipient's sentence, as every multi-slot notice did before this PR. Naming any number of slots would need a list-shaped keyed param in `@objectstack/service-messaging`, which is outside this card's surface. 8 is a declared constant, and the derived sentences cost one bundle entry per size per pack.
- **A deployment override** of `messages.approvalNoApproverHolding` does not reach the derived `…SlotsN` sentences. Those are their own catalog keys and can be overridden the same way.
- **The Approval Center's bulk approve** still reports failures by record title only. It shows no reason for any refusal, as before.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/no-approver-note.test.ts`. Expect every test to pass, including "a zh-CN decider reads each refusal entirely in Chinese, the position by its label".
